title: Permitted Obstructions
previewText: In the Core and North Subdistricts, the provisions of Section 33-42 (Permitted Obstructions) shall apply to all buildings. In addition, dormers may penetrate a maximum base height in accordance with the provisions of paragraph (b)(1) of Section 23-413 (Permitted obstructions in certain districts).
